question: What is the capital expenditure (CAPEX) allocated for Indian Railways in the financial year 2024-25?
solution:
The correct answer is __**₹2.62 lakh crore**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **capital expenditure (CAPEX) allocated for Indian Railways** in the financial year 2024-25 has been set at ₹2.62 lakh crore.
 
• This allocation marks a **significant increase** compared to previous years, underlining the government's focus on infrastructure development.
 
• It is the **highest-ever CAPEX allocation** for Indian Railways, aimed at modernizing and expanding railway infrastructure.
 
• The funds will be utilized for projects such as **track doubling, electrification, station redevelopment, and rolling stock acquisition**.
 
• Emphasis has also been placed on **high-speed rail projects** and improving passenger amenities across the railway network.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Capital Expenditure (CAPEX):**

 
 
• CAPEX refers to funds used by an organization or government to acquire, upgrade, and maintain physical assets like infrastructure, buildings, or equipment.
 
• In the context of Indian Railways, it includes investments in projects like electrification, new lines, and station redevelopment.
 
 
 
• **Indian Railways Modernization:**
 
 
• The modernization plan includes electrification of routes, the introduction of semi-high-speed and high-speed trains, and enhanced safety measures.
 
• It also focuses on automation and the use of technology to improve operational efficiency.
 
 
 
• **High-Speed Rail Projects:**
 
 
• India's flagship high-speed rail project is the Mumbai-Ahmedabad bullet train corridor.
 
• Such projects are expected to reduce travel time and boost regional economic growth.
 
 
 
• **Focus on Green Initiatives:**
 
 
• Indian Railways aims to achieve **net-zero carbon emissions by 2030**, with a focus on renewable energy and electrification of rail routes.
 
• Large-scale solar and wind energy projects are being integrated into railway operations.
 
 
 
• **Impact of Increased CAPEX:**
 
 
• Higher CAPEX in railways is expected to boost employment, regional connectivity, and economic growth.
 
• It is also likely to improve logistics efficiency, reducing costs for businesses and consumers.
